title: Generate a Random Permutation of the Elements of a List

entrypoints.name: permutation
requirements: Returns a list that is a permutation of the input: occurrence-sensitive multiset equality, including duplicates.
Returns a random ordering as required by the authoritative statement.
Has no seed or RNG-state argument; do not alter the unary public interface.

trusted_primitive_declarations.name: random_choice
trusted_primitive_declarations.kind: required runtime capability, not declared in an implementation artifact
trusted_primitive_declarations.purpose: Select one occurrence from a finite non-empty list and return it with the remaining occurrences.
semantic_requirements: Effectful/random selection; no deterministic seed is introduced into permutation's interface.
The returned remaining list preserves all and only unselected occurrences, including duplicates.
